title: Clamp Stuck at the Floor
rootCause: max(x, hi) is always >= hi, and min(lo, ...) is always <= lo, so the result is always lo. The nesting is inside-out.

wrongFixes.whyWrong: Returning x when it is in range fixes the visible case, but anything above hi now returns lo instead of hi.

turns.text: max(x, hi) is at least hi, so min(lo, that) is always lo. The nesting is inverted. It should be max(lo, min(x, hi)). I'll apply that and check both ends of the range.

test_failing: OK (1 test)

Both suites pass, including below-range, above-range and the exact edges.

grading.question: Why is the result always lo?
grading.ideal: max(x, hi) >= hi, then min(lo, that) <= lo, and lo <= hi makes it exactly lo.
